clue.text: HP mixed with couscous and tripe

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A recipe of brown sauce stirred into couscous and offal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tripe' looks like part of the dish but is the definition, in its slang sense of rubbish talk.
explanation.definitionFit: Tripe is slang for nonsense, and this reduplicated phrase likewise means trickery or meaningless talk.

clue.text: Tool holding earth over plant

clue.text: Topple leader in Uganda and await judgment

clue.text: Full of people — those not distinguished by rank, we hear

parts.note: the populace is the common people, without title or rank

clue.text: Fantastic place to come down to follow obscure bird

the cuckoo is a bird
to land is to come down to earth

clue.text: Heavy food unfortunately — so get trapped wind in the end

unfortunately signals the letters of so get going awry into a new order

explanation.walkthrough: 'unfortunately' turns SOGET into STOGE, and 'trapped' puts D, the last letter of 'wind', inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Stodge is a British word for heavy, filling, starchy food such as suet puddings.

clue.text: Having many possessions from mother I cherish

clue.text: Element scarce on planet

parts.note: something rare is scarce

clue.text: Seduce 6 out of 15? On the contrary

VI is six in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: Seduce six of fifteen? No, the reverse.
explanation.walkthrough: '6' and '15' look like cross-references but 6 is just the Roman numeral VI, while 15 is the entry 15 across.
